scope_note: Governed contribution synthesis for Google Council Bluffs. The completed 2012 Iowa award supplies a broad $1.7 billion qualified-investment base, but construction eligibility is first restricted through a 25%/50%/75% sensitivity that excludes or parameterizes IT equipment and other nonconstruction capital. Prince William County IMPLAN coefficients are transferred only as explicit benchmark equivalents, with direct, indirect, induced, and total construction job-years separated and protected by one aggregation. Local purchasing is a separate sensitivity rather than an observed supplier payment. Council Bluffs location water consumption is allocated to the selected inventory building only through a disclosed 25%/50%/75% share. No local tax receipt, actual abatement, grant payment, public-service cost, break-even threshold, or net fiscal result is modeled. County GDP, employment, and wage gaps are descriptive benchmark applications with fit-sensitivity ranges and no causal-design metadata.

sources.title: Google 2025 Environmental Report
sources.notes: The location schedule reports 2024 Council Bluffs water withdrawal of 1,410.3 million gallons, discharge of 400.1 million gallons, and consumption of 1,010.2 million gallons. The report defines consumption as withdrawal minus discharge and notes that discharge is estimated with engineering principles where actual data is unavailable. The location row does not allocate either Google facility, campus, or mapped building.
